Method & limits

What this map shows

Current building footprints, coloured by the construction-age band attached to residential EPC records. A building appears once its age band is reached; the map does not reconstruct buildings that were later demolished.

Footprints
OS OpenMap Local, April 2026.
Construction period
Domestic EPC attributes published by GeoDS/CDRC, 2022 snapshot. Periods are bands, not exact build years.
Height
Welsh Government LiDAR DSM minus DTM, sampled within each footprint. Gaps use a property-form estimate.
Coverage
Residential EPCs do not cover every footprint, particularly non-residential buildings.
